Decision gate (no weakening): each re-check runs the same admission function with the same thresholds; a wait that expires exits 76 with the last report.

description:
Source: a retrospective over 25 agent sessions (2026-10-18 to 2026-11-11), followed by an adversarial re-check of each claim against origin/develop 4835f5a537.

Problem. `make heavy-run` waits up to an hour for the host lock but refuses at once when admission fails (exit 76). docs/agent/heavy-work.md lists the code and gives no next step. Sessions wrote at least 47 retry loops around heavy-run and the targets that wrap it, and several background jobs died on their deadlines.

Owner decision 2026-11-11: add an opt-in admission wait; default behaviour is unchanged.

Change. benchbox/utils/host_lock.py `run`: an option that, when admission is refused, re-checks at a fixed interval until admitted or the wait expires, then proceeds or exits 76 as today. make/tests.mk heavy-run maps `HEAVY_ADMIT_WAIT=<minutes>` to it. make/help.mk names the variable on the heavy-run line. docs/agent/heavy-work.md documents the variable in the Commands table and says what to do on 76. Durations use benchbox.utils.clock (mono_time, elapsed_seconds).

Files: benchbox/utils/host_lock.py, make/tests.mk, make/help.mk, docs/agent/heavy-work.md, the existing host_lock unit test file, and one changelog fragment (benchbox/ is a shipped path; see changelog.d/README.md and make changelog-entry).

Non-goals. No change to admission thresholds, to the lock, the watchdog, or `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force`. Other targets that call host_lock are not given the variable in this item unless they already route through heavy-run.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone, and pass absolute worktree paths to every file tool; stage paths explicitly, never git add -A; no explanatory comments or docstrings (make comment-policy-check); heavy work only via make heavy-run, never forcing admission or skipping the test lock; never bypass a required check, ruleset, hold label or review gate, and never post a stand-in; change only the files this item names, and report anything else as noticed-but-not-touched; re-read every cited file on current origin/develop before editing, because the line numbers here are hints from 2026-11-11 (origin/develop 4835f5a537); close at a merged PR (make pr-open, make pr-arm), and finish this item only after the merge is observed.
